decision.summary: No heating/hot water with a vulnerable tenant, treated as emergency. First assignment to HeatRight failed once (HTTP 500, not applied) then verified on retry; HeatRight no-showed on 11 Oct. Recorded the missed visit, reassigned to Swift, informed tenant and landlord, escalated P1.

answers.question: What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: First assign_contractor call returned HTTP 500 and ledger A1 attempt 1 said NOT APPLIED. I retried once (safe, idempotent); attempt 2 verified by read-back with the ticket at stage visit, HeatRight, 11 Oct 08:00-12:00. I only told the tenant after that.

answers.question: What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: After verified assignment: HeatRight booked Sunday 8-12, please be home, gas emergency number. After no-show: apology, moved to Swift with a requested 15:00-19:00 slot that is not yet confirmed, warmth advice, gas number, will update when confirmed. By email, as the tenant prefers. The second send timed out but read-back showed it was sent (MSG-102), so not retried.

answers.question: After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Recorded missed_appointment, reassigned to Swift (emergency, so no landlord approval needed), SMSed Swift, emailed the landlord, escalated P1 to maintenance for phone confirmation and fallback heating, scheduled a follow-up for 12 Oct.
